app.name: MedTracker
app.disclaimer: Personal organization tool. It only stores and reminds you of what you enter yourself. It does not give medical advice, does not recommend medications or doses, and does not replace your doctor or pharmacist.
app.disclaimer_short: Personal reminder tool — not medical advice.

medication.title: Medications
medication.name: Medication name
medication.image_hint: Optional photo of the box or pill (PNG, JPG, GIF or WEBP, up to 4 MB).
medication.first_dose_hint: Defaults to the global first dose time from Settings. You can override it for this medication.
medication.empty_hint: Add your first medication to start tracking doses.
medication.end_date_optional_hint: Leave empty for an ongoing treatment with no planned end.

confirm.delete_medication_body: "{name}" and all of its dose history will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone. If you only want to stop the reminders and keep the history, use Suspend instead.
confirm.delete_appointment_body: The appointment with {doctor} and its reminders will be permanently deleted. Linked medications are not deleted.
confirm.suspend_body: Reminders stop and upcoming doses are removed. Everything already recorded is kept, and you can resume at any time.
confirm.resume_body: Upcoming doses will be regenerated from now until the end date, using this medication's own schedule.
confirm.complete_body: Reminders stop and upcoming doses are removed. The history is kept.
confirm.first_dose_change_title: Change the global first dose time?
confirm.first_dose_change_body: Upcoming doses of your {count} active medication(s) will be recalculated to start at {time}. Doses already marked as taken, skipped or missed are never changed.
confirm.delete_doctor_body: "{name}" will be permanently deleted. Their appointments are not deleted, so a doctor with appointments cannot be removed until you delete or reassign those first.
confirm.complete_early_body: This medication is scheduled to end on {end}. Today is {today}. Are you sure you want to complete it now?
confirm.complete_open_ended_body: This treatment has no end date. Are you sure you want to complete it now?
confirm.taken_early_body: This dose is scheduled for {scheduled}. It is currently {now}. Are you sure you want to mark it as taken now?

appointment.title: Medical appointments
appointment.notes_placeholder: Anything you want to remember about this visit
appointment.next_appointment_hint: Follow-up date given by the doctor. You can turn it into a real appointment later.
appointment.medications_hint: Link medications you are already tracking to this appointment.
appointment.medications_empty: No medications linked to this appointment.
appointment.empty_hint: Add an appointment to get reminders before it.
appointment.was_prescribed_at: Prescribed at the appointment with {doctor} on {date}
appointment.is_follow_up: Is this a follow-up of a previous appointment?
appointment.follow_up_none: No earlier appointment to choose from.
appointment.follow_up_hint: Only appointments scheduled before this one can be chosen.
appointment.add_doctor_first: Add a doctor first — every appointment belongs to one.

reminder.none_enabled: No reminders enabled for this appointment.

settings.title: Settings
settings.language_hint: The app starts in your browser's language. Choosing one here overrides it and is remembered.
settings.default_first_dose_hint: Used as the starting hour for new medications. Changing it also recalculates the upcoming doses of your active medications — doses already marked are never touched.
settings.ending_soon_hint: Show a warning on the dashboard when a treatment ends within this many days.
settings.missed_after_minutes: Mark a dose as missed after
settings.missed_after_hint: An unmarked dose becomes "missed" this many minutes after its scheduled time. A dose is never marked as taken automatically.
settings.windows_notifications_hint: Desktop toasts sent by the background service. These work even when the browser is closed.
settings.browser_notifications_hint: Shown by this page while it is open. Any reminder you missed appears the next time you open the app.
settings.appointment_reminder_defaults_hint: Used as the default for new appointments. Each appointment can still be configured on its own.
settings.permission_denied: Your browser blocked notifications for this site. Allow them in the browser's site settings to use this channel.
settings.permission_unsupported: This browser does not support notifications.
settings.scheduler_stopped: Not running. Start the app with start.bat so reminders can fire.
settings.windows_unavailable: Windows notifications are unavailable on this system ({reason}). The app keeps working; only desktop toasts are off.
settings.email_notifications_hint: Sends the same reminders to your inbox. Works from any device, and keeps a record you can search later.
settings.email_sender_hint: Usually the same as the SMTP username. Left empty, the username is used.
settings.smtp_password_hint: Leave empty to keep the password already stored. Clear it and save to forget it.
settings.test_email_failed: The test email could not be sent.
settings.secret_dpapi: The password is encrypted with Windows DPAPI: only your Windows account, on this machine, can read it back.
settings.secret_file: This system has no Windows DPAPI, so the password is kept in data/secret_store.json with owner-only permissions. Noticeably weaker — it is meant for development.
settings.dose_reminders_hint: Each scheduled dose can be announced several times. Turn off the ones you do not want.
settings.gmail_hint: For Gmail use smtp.gmail.com, port 587, and an app password — not your normal account password.
settings.missed_before_offsets: This is shorter than your latest dose reminder ({minutes} min after). A dose becomes overdue before that reminder can fire, so it will not be sent.

validation.quantity_positive: Quantity must be greater than zero.
validation.end_before_start: The end date cannot be before the start date.
validation.appointment_datetime_required: Enter the appointment date and time.
validation.treatment_too_long: This treatment is longer than 5 years. Please shorten it.
validation.image_too_large: The image is larger than 4 MB.
validation.image_type: Only PNG, JPG, GIF or WEBP images are allowed.
validation.missed_range: Enter a number between 5 and 1440 minutes.
validation.doctor_has_appointments: This doctor still has appointments. Delete or move them first.
validation.follow_up_self: An appointment cannot be a follow-up of itself.
validation.follow_up_not_earlier: Choose an appointment scheduled before this one.
validation.email_incomplete: Fill in the SMTP host and the recipient before enabling email.
validation.follow_up_would_invert: Another appointment follows up on this one and is scheduled later. Move that one first.

error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.network: Cannot reach the application. Is it still running?
error.database: The database could not be reached. Check that the app has write access to its data folder.
error.notification_permission: Notifications are blocked in this browser.
error.windows_notifications_unavailable: Windows notifications are not available on this machine.
error.email_failed: The email could not be sent.

notification.test_body: If you can read this, notifications are working.
notification.dose_lead_before: In {minutes} minutes you need to take:
notification.dose_lead_after: {minutes} minutes ago you were due to take:
notification.dose_lead_overdue: This dose was not marked and is now overdue:

doctor.title: Doctors
doctor.name: Name
doctor.notes_placeholder: Clinic, insurance, anything you want to remember
doctor.no_appointments: No appointments with this doctor yet.
doctor.empty_hint: Add a doctor to start recording appointments.
